_note: GST rule pack (I5): how late a credit note may still reduce tax (s. 34(2)).

explain.en: A credit note that reduces tax must be declared by 30 November after the end of the financial year of the invoice, or the date of the annual return, whichever is earlier.
explain.hi-Latn: Tax kam karne wali credit note us saal ke baad 30 November tak, ya annual return se pehle, jo pehle ho.
